nodes.label: BMW E90 vehicle model data sources
nodes.rationale: Vehicle parameters come from SAE 2007-01-0818 (NADS 2006 BMW 330i parameterization); missing powertrain data are filled from a public BMW datasheet and other internet sources.

nodes.label: Duro multipurpose transport vehicle model
nodes.rationale: Modeled to demonstrate the unusual Bucher/Mowag Duro suspension principle; almost all data are estimated from Wikipedia, enthusiast sites and drawings because no manufacturer dataset is public.

nodes.label: FED Alpha tactical vehicle model
nodes.rationale: Data from the Keweenaw Research Center public release; the 3D graphic representation is derived from the CAD files and tire files come from public sources.

nodes.label: Gator utility vehicle model
nodes.rationale: Based on a John Deere TE 4x2 E-Gator; parameters taken from manufacturer brochures and adjusted for payload modifications, with tire data estimated from OEM tire specs (22.5x10-8 front, 25x12-9 rear).

nodes.label: Mercedes G-class (G500) vehicle model
nodes.rationale: The real G-Class suspension uses elasto-kinematic elements; the Chrono model deliberately simplifies it to a pure kinematic design.

nodes.label: Kraz semi-trailer truck model
nodes.rationale: Longhaul model pairing a Krone dry-liner semi-trailer with a Kraz 64431 tractor; all data extracted from the two manufacturers' public brochures.

nodes.label: M113 tracked APC model data sources
nodes.rationale: Assembled from several public sources - Wallin/Shabana joint-formulation and chain-dynamics studies, Afonso's ride-dynamics thesis, Keays' track load/stress report, and a Tankograd reference volume - since no single authoritative parameter set exists.

nodes.label: MAN Kat 1 truck models
nodes.rationale: Chassis data from P. Ocker's MAN book, engine data from Deutz, tire data estimated from a Pacejka truck tire dataset.

nodes.label: mrole multi-role vehicle model
nodes.rationale: A simplified stand-in for the KMW/RLS 'Boxer'. Engine, drivetrain and suspension approximate the original from manufacturer data, but the steering system is simplified and functional only, because details of the military modules are not publicly available.

nodes.label: MTV/LMTV truck models
nodes.rationale: Derived from the public M1078-series LMTV operator's instruction manual (TM-9-2320-365-10).

nodes.label: Polaris MRZR ATV model
nodes.rationale: Based in part on SEA Ltd. VIMF kinematics-and-compliance measurements and dynamic handling/stability tests of a 2013 Polaris MRZR. Documented in the README even though no polaris/ file group exists in the vehicle-models CMakeLists, so the model data lives outside this library target.

nodes.label: UAZ 452/469 vehicle models
nodes.rationale: The Chrono UAZ 469 represents the older design with two solid axles, not the currently sold 'Hunter' which has independent front suspension.

nodes.label: Unimog U401 truck model
nodes.rationale: Vintage Boehringer/Daimler-Benz U401; the main data source is enthusiast-community material (1955 Frosch data sheet) and suspension and steering parameters have been estimated.

nodes.label: Synthetic-data fallback policy for vehicle models
nodes.rationale: For vehicle models not listed in the README, 'synthetic data set at reasonable values' are used. The README exists to make the provenance boundary explicit between measured/published parameters and invented ones.
